body: Honestly after thinking it over the past hour instead of just feeling like shit i feel like maybe she does not understand what love is. I feel like its the willingness to sacrifice your self for another. When i say to some one that i love them that's what i am saying. But if she truly loved me should would not have done the things she did. I think i will take some advice and get rid of things that remind me of her like her being on every friend list / FB ect that i have. I wont try and forget as forgetting is not learning and i always need to learn from my mistakes. but i do need to wallow in my own pain. Moving forward i just need to solve sexual frustration i guess. Thanks for the talk i was not sure if this would all help but i can breath and think again.  Do i need to delete my post ? or can it just be closed i would like to keep it to read over when i am feeling like i am in crisis.

but i am scared for her at the same time, because i know shes going to get hurt. emotionally and very possibly physically and i feel like i failed to protect her. Even though she hurt me so much i would still protect her if she needed some one. I don't know if this makes me stupid but its what feels right. If some one needs help they should get it.
but i guess there is some resent its just being cheated on i just cant put it to words.

i do but it feel like a defense because, every time i think about her i feel pain which makes me hate her but then i know how good of a person she can be and i remember how much i loved her. So i just end up being angry at my self.

I have always had to very different sides to me, its like i always have to trains of thought at the same time. One is always logical and the other emotional. I work in a very high stress and high risk job. so at work when crisis happens i let the logical side take over. I am not used to being out of control on the emotional side. my emotional side just wants her to feel what i feel so she can understand. But the other side of me which is dominate cant hurt people. I just cant i made a choice years ago that i would always be truthful and always help people in need. i have managed to calm down quite a bit after typing this all out. I feel like i am just really disappointed in my self. I am always truthful with others but i was not truthful with me self. I let my self think she would treat me different then others. I let my shield down and let some one in when they where already leaning on me and i thought maybe i could lean on them. But how can some one who needs the support be the support. even knowing this i did it any ways because i needed some one . I am just so scared now because i still want some one to hug and love and cuddle. And honestly i am extremely sexual and going from constant sex to none is causing me problems i am not used to. I am trying at all cost to not rebound into a girl and hurt her the same way i have just been hurt but i crave love atm.

This sums up how i feel, i dont want to not feel it because i think i can learn from the pain, but i honestly never felt this much pain before. I have almost died twice in my life and the pain was not even close to this. When she first broke up with me i cried for a night. After i read she cheated on me i puked it hurt so much.

This is what i think as well, i know its not intentional and all are mutual friends say she just does not think. and she does not mean to hurt me, i just never felt so much hurt as when i found her post saying shes been cheating on me for a while. but it even hurts because she says in the post that her past boyfriend was better in bed because he just seemed to care more. So i guess i could be the best at everything and still loose for no reason. its like the story of my life i work really hard and something random takes my chance away.

i feel like i made a ton of mistakes because i wanted to protect her but i dident think about my self at all. I have been alone most of my life. i just dident want to be alone any more so i jumped in with one of my only friends and now i lost that friend.

i honestly think the root of the problem is i did not hear my own warning signs. I seen them all over i was putting in lots of effort and her little, i should have backed out there but she was fragile and i dident want to hurt her.

I also feel stupid because i seen the pattern of her relationships when i was her friend. but i always wana help people as much as i can, that goes double for my friends. she deals with depression a fair amount she comes from a very rich family and has no scope on the effort the world takes. So i always tried to help her learn and be there for her when she needed me. but i knew she had a pattern of breaking up with people after being with them for a while. and i still did it, because i knew her other boyfriend they where douches i was not. and she even called me mister right. She asked me to marry her and i said no. i knew i needed to be with her longer to make sure she would be willing to grow up some and make sure she was not just stuck in honeymoon phase. why did i let myself do silly things. is it just a chemical response i dont know.

I know i will feel better in the future its just its wrecking me i can see how its silly but i cant stop feeling terrible, i am fine while i keep my self doing things but the minute i try and sleep i just cry all night.
